messages.subject: adjusting colors in clustersamples and pcasamples in methylkit

Dear all,

Can anyone help me, how to change the default colors in clustersamples and pcasamples?

Many thanks in advance, Rahel

messages.author: ab8277113f65c05e
messages.subject: Re: [methylkit_discussion] adjusting colors in clustersamples and pcasamples in methylkit
parts:
colors are default. the PCA function returns the PCA invisibly. You can get the PCA coordinates from that and do a scatter plot yourself.

pcs=PCASamples(methylBase.obj)
loads = pcs$rotation
plot(loads[,1],loads[,2])

messages.subject: Re: [methylkit_discussion] adjusting colors in clustersamples and pcasamples in methylkit
parts:
if someone was interested to get their own color codes clustersamples:
c <- clusterSamples(meth, dist="correlation", method="ward", plot=F)
labelColors = c("#CD0000","#8B4789","#006400","#104E8B")
clusMember <- c("Ctrl1"=1, "Ctrl2"=1,"Ctrl3"=1,"KO1"=2,"KO2"=2, "KO3"=2, "A1"=3,"A2"=3,"A3"=3, "A-KO1"=4, "A-KO2"=4, "A-KO3"=4) 
# function to get color labels
colLab <- function(n) {
    if (is.leaf(n)) {
        a <- attributes(n)
        labCol <- labelColors[clusMember[which(names(clusMember) == a$label)]]
        attr(n, "nodePar") <- c(a$nodePar, lab.col = labCol)
    }
    n
}
# using dendrapply
clusDendro = dendrapply(as.dendrogram(c), colLab)
# make plot
plot(clusDendro, main = "CpG methylation Clustering")

####
